metadata.description: Benchmark evaluation dataset for Insurance Requirements Agent covering 3 Lines of Business (Auto, Homeowners, Life).

extraction_golden_set.expected_clause: Part D - Coverage for Damage to Your Auto
Part D - Coverage for Damage to Your Auto

extraction_golden_set.expected_value: Commercial delivery or rideshare without explicit endorsement
Organized racing, speed contests, or stunting events
10 days for non-payment, 30 days for underwriting reasons
Flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, and storm surge
Earthquake, landslide, mudflow, and earth sinkhole
Legacy Shield 20-Year Level Term Life Specification
31 days grace period for premium payments
Up to 75% of face value or maximum $250,000 for terminal illness <= 12 months
Premium waived upon total continuous disability exceeding 6 months

requirements_golden_set.title: Split Limits Liability Rating Rule
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Calculate split-limit bodily injury and property damage premiums

requirements_golden_set.title: Rideshare Delivery Exclusion Enforcement
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Block or surcharge vehicle engaged in rideshare service without endorsement

requirements_golden_set.title: Roadside Towing Limit Adjudication
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Cap roadside reimbursement at $100 per disablement

requirements_golden_set.title: Collision Deductible Application
requirements_golden_set.must_cite_clause: Part D - Coverage for Damage to Your Auto
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Deduct $500 from approved physical damage repair settlement

requirements_golden_set.title: Statutory Cancellation Notice Window
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Issue notice 10 days prior for non-payment or 30 days for underwriting

requirements_golden_set.title: Rental Reimbursement Per-Diem Cap
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Limit car rental to $40 daily and $1,200 aggregate

requirements_golden_set.title: Household Driver Disclosure Requirement
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Require endorsement for resident drivers residing over 60 days

requirements_golden_set.title: Comprehensive Deductible Application
requirements_golden_set.must_cite_clause: Part D - Coverage for Damage to Your Auto
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Apply $250 deductible for non-collision animal strike or hail damage

requirements_golden_set.title: Dwelling Replacement Cost Coverage A
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Rate base structural dwelling value up to $350,000

requirements_golden_set.title: Other Structures Percentage Formula
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Derive Coverage B automatically as 10% of Coverage A ($35,000)

requirements_golden_set.title: Personal Property Percentage Formula
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Derive Coverage C automatically as 50% of Coverage A ($175,000)

requirements_golden_set.title: Loss of Use Percentage Formula
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Derive Coverage D automatically as 20% of Coverage A ($70,000)

requirements_golden_set.title: Hurricane Percentage Deductible Calculator
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Calculate 2% of Coverage A ($7,000) for named tropical storm damage

requirements_golden_set.title: Standard All-Peril Property Deductible
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Withhold $1,000 base deductible on covered fire or wind losses

requirements_golden_set.title: Statutory Flood Peril Exclusion
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Disallow claims arising from surface runoff, rising river, or storm surge

requirements_golden_set.title: Water Backup Sump Pump Limit
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Apply $10,000 sublimit and $250 deductible for sewer/drain backup

requirements_golden_set.title: Scheduled Personal Property Itemization
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Maintain scheduled floater registry for high-value fine arts and jewelry

requirements_golden_set.title: Issue Age Eligibility Validation
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Validate applicant age is between 18 and 65 years at policy issue

requirements_golden_set.title: Face Amount Threshold Boundaries
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Enforce minimum coverage of $100,000 and maximum of $2,500,000

requirements_golden_set.title: Two-Year Incontestability and Suicide Defense
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Refund paid premiums without death benefit if suicide occurs within 24 months

requirements_golden_set.title: Grace Period Premium Lapse Prevention
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Maintain active coverage during 31-day grace period post invoice due date

requirements_golden_set.title: Accelerated Death Benefit Terminal Illness Payout
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Disburse up to 75% or max $250,000 on physician diagnosis of <= 12 months

requirements_golden_set.title: Total Disability Waiver of Premium
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Waive monthly premiums following 6 consecutive months of qualified disability

requirements_golden_set.title: Level Term 20-Year Guarantee Schedule
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Fix premium rates without increase for exactly 240 policy months

requirements_golden_set.title: Beneficiary Designation Registry
requirements_golden_set.expected_gherkin_scenario: Record primary and contingent beneficiaries with percentage allocations

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the policy coverage limit and deductible for overland flood and rising river water?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Flood is explicitly excluded in Section I General Exclusions.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the pet injury medical coverage limit under the auto policy?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Pet injury is not covered or mentioned in the auto policy document.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the earthquake deductible for the vehicle?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Earthquake deductibles do not exist in personal auto comprehensive terms.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the cash surrender value accumulation schedule after 10 years?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Term life policies have no cash surrender value accumulation.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the bodily injury split limit for commercial delivery on premises?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Homeowners HO-3 provides Section II Personal Liability with single aggregate, not commercial split limits.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the deductible for accidental death claims?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Life insurance contracts do not have deductibles.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the term life conversion rider specification?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Life insurance riders do not exist in personal auto policies.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the mechanical engine breakdown coverage limit?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Engine breakdown is an automobile concept, completely absent from HO-3.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the collision repair deductible for terminal illness claims?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Collision repair is invalid for term life insurance.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the hurricane deductible for commercial cargo in transit?
negative_test_cases.expected_explanation: Commercial cargo in transit is not covered under residential HO-3 forms.
